items.html:
Implemented and frozen for the next benchmark:

  • Shared spherical harmonic tables, including analytic Hessians.
  • Bounded per-sample storage; compact forward entries.
  • Scalar path for sparse/interleaved bases.
  • Regular-origin series reduced from 32 to 12 terms; omitted tail bounded below 4e-33 relative.

25 focused Rust tests passed, including independent AMOS reference values, physical/gradient contracts, exact scalar-wave comparisons and thread-count reproducibility. Independent reviews found no correctness blockers.

No Python extension build, timing, documentation changes, commits or pushes performed. Current speedups still need the next central release benchmark.

items.html:
Outgoing radial batching is ready for stage 3.

It fills the existing cache with one Hankel sequence per sufficiently populated centre/wavenumber group. Sparse groups retain scalar calls; dispatch is independent of mode order, and forward/pullback request only their required degrees.

Validation passed:

  • 27 focused field/harmonic/wave tests.
  • New lmax=12 complete reference, permutation, physical and gradient contract.
  • Per-centre overflow-bound regression.
  • Corrected direct AMOS regular-series reference.
  • Independent review found no blockers.

Existing tolerances remain unchanged. Files are frozen; no extension build, timing, commit or push performed.

items.html:
Stage 6 is implemented and frozen.

Radial batching now uses contiguous needed radial degrees, independently of harmonic density. Single dipoles qualify; widely separated sparse degrees retain scalar evaluation.

All nine focused tests passed with PROPTEST_CASES=1024, preserving existing tolerances, permutation invariance, gradients and per-centre bounds.

Reversible patch: stage6-fields.patch.

No extension build or performance timing performed.

items.html:
Added two cases:

  • prepared-dipole-cluster-map-n32-l1-p4096-forward
  • prepared-dipole-cluster-map-n32-l1-p4096-field-gradient

They sample a solved, disordered 32-sphere dipole cluster on a 64×64 plane above it. Particle construction and multiple-scattering solve occur outside timing. The gradient case includes field evaluation and its analytic pullback, excluding differentiation through the preceding solve.

Original cases are preserved. Prechange harness and its SHA-256 were recorded in the evidence directory. Ruff lint, formatting check and diff check pass. No build or timing performed.
